title: Nevada cites 10-year low for Super Bowl bets

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Nevada cites 10-year low for Super Bowl bets
sources.description: Approximately $133.8 million was bet on Super Bowl LX with Nevada sportsbooks, a 10-year low, with a net of $9.9 million on the Seahawks' 29-13 win over the Patriots, down 55% from last year.
